import pathlib,subprocess,json,re,collections,os,time
r=pathlib.Path("/private/tmp/goway-stage11-rc30578f82-laneC5");results={};families={}
for side,tree in [("baseline","Foundry-Go-measure-main"),("branch","Foundry-Go-goway-laneC5")]:
 cwd=pathlib.Path("/Users/weiloon/Projects/rust-go")/tree/"tests/fixtures/consumer"
 command=["go","list","-export","-f","{{.Export}}","./models"]
 archive=pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(command,cwd=cwd,text=True).strip())
 count=0;counts=collections.Counter();proc=subprocess.Popen(["go","tool","nm",str(archive)],cwd=cwd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 for line in proc.stdout:
  if not re.search(r"\s[Tt]\s",line):continue
  count+=1
  for name in ("Codec[","Query[","RowExpression[","Scalar[","Number[","Nullable["):
   if name in line:counts[name]+=1
 assert proc.wait()==0
 results[side]={"archive_bytes":archive.stat().st_size,"functions":count,"archive_path":str(archive),"cwd":str(cwd),"export_command":command,"nm_exit":proc.returncode,"load_average":os.getloadavg()}
 families[side]=dict(counts)
 print(side,results[side]["archive_bytes"],count,flush=True)
(r/"fixture-models.json").write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+"\n");(r/"fixture-models-families.json").write_text(json.dumps(families,indent=2)+"\n")

import json,os,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,time
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/goway-stage11-rc30578f82-laneC5')
BRANCH=pathlib.Path('/Users/weiloon/Projects/rust-go/Foundry-Go-goway-laneC5')
MAIN=pathlib.Path('/Users/weiloon/Projects/rust-go/Foundry-Go-measure-main')
TOOL=BRANCH/'tools/goway_synthetic.py'
state={'conditions':{'models':70,'handlers':40,'reports':5,'seed':1,'GOMAXPROCS':4,'GOFLAGS':'-p=4 (measurement adds -mod=readonly)'},'trials':[]}
def save(): (ROOT/'synthetic-sessions.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n')
def disk(label):
 text=subprocess.check_output(['df','-h','/System/Volumes/Data'],text=True)
 (ROOT/(label+'-disk.txt')).write_text(text)
 s=os.statvfs('/System/Volumes/Data');total=s.f_blocks*s.f_frsize;free=s.f_bavail*s.f_frsize
 pct=int(text.splitlines()[-1].split()[4].rstrip('%'))
 if pct>=85 or (total-free+40*1024**3)/total>=.85:raise RuntimeError('disk limit / conservative 40 GiB reserve: '+text)
 return {'df':text,'load_average':os.getloadavg(),'utc':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime())}
def run(argv,label):
 entry={'argv':list(map(str,argv)),'conditions_before':disk(label)};start=time.monotonic()
 with (ROOT/(label+'.log')).open('wb') as log:
  done=subprocess.run(list(map(str,argv)),cwd=BRANCH,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 entry.update(exit=done.returncode,wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-start,load_average_after=os.getloadavg())
 return entry
for trial in range(1,6):
 target=ROOT/f'synthetic70-trial{trial}';cache=ROOT/'caches'/f'synthetic70-trial{trial}'
 order='old,new' if trial%2 else 'new,old'
 record={'trial':trial,'order':order,'target':str(target),'cache':str(cache)};state['trials'].append(record);save()
 record['generation']=run(['python3',TOOL,'generate',target,'--repo',BRANCH,'--style','both','--old-repo',MAIN,'--models','70','--handlers','40','--reports','5','--seed','1'],f'synthetic70-trial{trial}-generate');save()
 if record['generation']['exit']:raise RuntimeError('synthetic generation failed; see retained log')
 record['measurement']=run(['python3',TOOL,'measure',target,'--cache',cache,'--order',order],f'synthetic70-trial{trial}-measure');save()
 if record['measurement']['exit']:raise RuntimeError('synthetic measurement failed; see retained log')
 result=json.loads((target/'measurement/measurement.json').read_text());assert result['complete']
 record['completed']=True;record['cache_recorded_before_removal']=True;save()
 assert cache.parent==ROOT/'caches' and not cache.is_symlink()
 shutil.rmtree(cache);record['cache_removed']=True;save()
 print('Completed synthetic paired trial',trial,'order',order,flush=True)
state['complete']=True;save()
